question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    rc.year,
    r.driver_id,
    MIN(rc.round) as first_round,
    MAX(rc.round) as last_round
  FROM results r
  JOIN races rc ON r.race_id = rc.race_id
  WHERE rc.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  GROUP BY rc.year, r.driver_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.round) >= 2
),
first_race_constructor AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (rc.year, r.driver_id)
    rc.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id
  FROM results r
  JOIN races rc ON r.race_id = rc.race_id
  WHERE rc.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  ORDER BY rc.year, r.driver_id, rc.round
),
last_race_constructor AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (rc.year, r.driver_id)
    rc.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id
  FROM results r
  JOIN races rc ON r.race_id = rc.race_id
  WHERE rc.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  ORDER BY rc.year, r.driver_id, rc.round DESC
)
SELECT DISTINCT drv.forename, drv.surname, drv.nationality
FROM first_race_constructor frc
JOIN last_race_constructor lrc ON frc.year = lrc.year AND frc.driver_id = lrc.driver_id
JOIN driver_first_last dfl ON frc.year = dfl.year AND frc.driver_id = dfl.driver_id
JOIN drivers drv ON frc.driver_id = drv.driver_id
WHERE frc.constructor_id = lrc.constructor_id
ORDER BY drv.surname, drv.forename

    rc.year,
    r.driver_id,
    MIN(rc.round) as first_round,

  FROM results r

),
last_race_constructor AS (

    rc.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id

)
